name: How long does a typical flooring repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of flooring repair varies significantly based on the type of flooring, the extent of the damage, and the specific repair method. Simple repairs, such as replacing a few planks or tiles, might take a few hours to a full day. More complex repairs, like extensive hardwood refinishing or significant subfloor work, could require several days, including drying and curing times for finishes or adhesives. We provide an estimated timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to several days for complex jobs, depending on flooring type and damage extent.
